reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed: updateMemberAdmin has a non-test caller (MemberManagementClient.tsx:253) and is exported, no trust_assumptions defined in scope file, and src/lib/actions/members.ts is explicitly in scope. Spec deviation is confirmed — user_edit_logs table is entirely absent from the codebase. Attack path requires a compromised or malicious admin; the impact is that all admin mutations to member records (name, generation, student_number, status, team memberships) are permanently undetectable with no forensic trail.
